description: Secretaria Municipal da Saúde (SMS) with SMDU, City of São Paulo publishes a register of all municipal health facilities of the city, compiled by the municipal urban development information department, published as 24 files including a yearly database from 2004 onwards and a metadata sheet; the page says the dataset was discontinued and its last version is from 30 December 2014, and points to the national CNES downloads for current information. Coverage: the municipality of São Paulo, 2004 to 2014; the portal record was modified on 2026-06-09. Format and access: CSV, XLS, downloadable without registration from the São Paulo municipal open data portal; the portal also serves the metadata through a public API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Creative Commons CCZero; cost: free. Caveats: the register is discontinued and stops in 2014, so it does not show current facilities; the files were not opened, so columns and counts are unconfirmed; the national CNES establishment database is the current source. Simulation uses: historical facility layers for healthcare accessibility and capacity studies and as a baseline to compare with CNES, and for long-term change in service coverage. Related catalogue records: OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
